faqs.question: Is bat removal legal in New York City?
faqs.answer: Yes, but it must be done humanely and according to NYC regulations. Bats are protected species, so removal must occur during specific seasons (typically after maternity season ends in August) and cannot harm the animals. A Best Pest Control NYC technician — licensed by the NYS DEC or working under the direct supervision of a licensed applicator — ensures full compliance with all local and state wildlife laws.

faqs.question: How do I know if I have bats in my Briarwood home?
faqs.answer: Common signs include scratching or squeaking sounds at dusk or dawn, droppings (guano) in attics or near entry points, brown staining around gaps in siding or rooflines, and seeing bats flying around your property at twilight. If you notice any of these signs, contact us immediately for an inspection.

faqs.question: What does the bat exclusion process involve?
faqs.answer: Our comprehensive process includes a detailed inspection to locate all entry points, installation of one-way exclusion devices that allow bats to leave but not return, sealing of all potential entry points with durable materials, attic cleanup and sanitization if needed.
